why: Removes the non-vacuity guard, which is the one failure a size budget is most likely to have: a build that emitted no JavaScript weighs nothing and is therefore under every ceiling. tools/portability/check.mjs carries the same guard because its own predecessor passed on an empty dist/ -- a shell `! grep` over a non-matching glob exits 0. Without this, a broken build reports "within budget" and the gate is worse than nothing, because it reads as evidence.
killedBy: bundle budget: what it refuses REFUSES a build with no JavaScript, which is under every ceiling
